items.body_raw: ויאמר לו המלך תנה־לי את־כרמך בכסף ויאמר לא־אתן לך את־כרמי
items.answer_raw: And the king said to him, Give me thy vineyard for money; and he said, I will not give thee my vineyard.

items.body_raw: Abraham saw a ram taken by (בְּ) his horns.
items.answer_raw: רָאָה אַבְרָהָם אַיִל נֶאֱחָז בְּקַרְנָיו

items.body_raw: Love wisdom, forsake her not.
items.answer_raw: אֱהַב חָכְמָה אַל־תַּעַזְבֶנָּה

items.body_raw: They said unto him, To bind thee have we come down, to give thee into the hand of thine enemies.
items.answer_raw: אָמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסָרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד אֹיְבֶיךָ (or אֵלָיו for לוֹ)

items.body_raw: And the people served (pl.) their God all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who prolonged days after Joshua.
items.answer_raw: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כָּל־יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָל־יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר יהוה אֶל־הָאָדָם מִכָּל־עֵץ הַגָּן אָכֹל תֹּאכֵל
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh said to the man, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat.

items.body_raw: אִם־תֹּאבוּ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּם טוּב הָאָרֶץ תֹּאכֵלוּ
items.answer_raw: If ye be willing and hearken, ye shall eat the good of the land.

items.body_raw: וְהַאֲכַלְתִּים אֶת־בְּשַׂר בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֵת בְּשַׂר בְּנֹתֵיהֶם
items.answer_raw: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters.

items.body_raw: קַח־לְךָ מִכָּל־מַאֲכָל אֲשֶׁר יֵאָכֵל וְהָיָה לְךָ וְלָהֶם לְאָכְלָה
items.answer_raw: Take unto thee of every kind of food that is eaten, and it shall be for food for thee and for them.

items.body_raw: יהוה אַל־נָא נֹאבְדָה בְּנֶפֶשׁ הָאִישׁ הַזֶּה וְאַל־תִּתֵּן עָלֵינוּ דָּם נָקִיא
items.answer_raw: O Yahweh, do not, we entreat thee, let us perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר הָאִשָּׁה הַזֹּאת אָמְרָה אֵלַי תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ הַיּוֹם וְאֶת־בְּנִי נֹאכַל מָחָר וַנְּבַשֵּׁל אֶת־בְּנִי וַנֹּאכְלֵהוּ וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ בַּיּוֹם הָאַחֵר תְּנִי אֶת־בְּנֵךְ וְנֹאכְלֶנּוּ וַתַּחְבִּא אֶת־בְּנָהּ
items.answer_raw: And the king said to the woman, What aileth thee? and she said, This woman said to me, Give thy son that we may eat him to-day, and my son we will eat to-morrow. So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her the next day, Give thy son that we may eat him, but she hid her son.

items.body_raw: ותקח האשה מפרי העץ ותאכל ותתן גם לאישה ויאכל
items.answer_raw: And the woman took of the fruit of the tree and ate, and she gave also to her husband, and he ate.

items.body_raw: האכלתם לחם במדבר
items.answer_raw: Thou gavest them bread to eat in the wilderness.

items.body_raw: Ye shall eat of the fruit of your ways.
items.answer_raw: תֹּאכְלוּ מִפְּרִי דַרְכֵיכֶם

items.body_raw: Let us not perish for his soul.
items.answer_raw: אַל־נָא נֹאבְדָה בְּנַפְשׁוֹ

items.body_raw: And he called the people to eat and they ate.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־הָעָם לֶאֱכֹל וַיֹּאכֵלוּ

items.body_raw: And the children of Israel said, Who will let-us-eat (Hiph.) flesh?
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי יַאֲכִלֵנוּ בָּשָׂר

items.body_raw: Ye shall not eat any carcase; to the stranger ye shall give it and he shall eat it.
items.answer_raw: לֹא תֹאכְלוּ כָל־נְבֵלָה לַגֵּר תִּתְּנֶנָּה וַאֲכָלָהּ

items.body_raw: Give me flesh that I may eat.
items.answer_raw: תְּנָה־לִּי בָשָׂר וְאֹכֵלָה (or, less emphatically, תֶּן־לִי)

items.body_raw: It shall not be eaten, it shall be burned in the fire.
items.answer_raw: לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף

items.body_raw: And the dogs ate the flesh of my calf.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאכְלוּ הַכְּלָבִים אֶת־בְּשַׂר עֶגְלִי

items.body_raw: The Philistines gathered together (אסף, Niph.) and seized Samson and bound him with fetters of bronze.
items.answer_raw: נֶאֶסְפוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אֶת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיַּאַסְרֻהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם

items.body_raw: ביום ההוא תאמרי לי אישי ולא תקראי לי עוד בעלי
items.answer_raw: In that day thou shalt say to me, My husband, and thou shalt no more call me, My lord.

items.body_raw: Thou shalt love Yahweh thy God and him thou shalt serve.
items.answer_raw: תֶּאֱהַב אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְאֹתוֹ תַעֲבֹד

items.body_raw: Let those-loving (ptc. cstr.) thy salvation say: Let God be great!
items.answer_raw: יֹאמְרוּ אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתְךָ יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים

items.body_raw: כַּרְמֵיכֶם וְזֵיתֵיכֶם יֹאכַל הָאַרְבֶּה
items.answer_raw: Your vineyards and olive-trees the locusts repeatedly devoured.

items.body_raw: Yahweh shall assuredly destroy the work of thy hands.
items.answer_raw: אַבֵּד יְאַבֵּד יְהוָה אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ

items.body_raw: If I perish, I perish.
items.answer_raw: כַּאֲשֶׁר אָבַדְתִּי אָבָדְתִּי

items.body_raw: אֹהֵב יהוה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב
items.answer_raw: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling-places of Jacob.

items.body_raw: And he loved Joseph more than all his sons, for a son of old age (was) he to him.
items.answer_raw: וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִכָּל־בָּנָיו כִּי־בֶן־זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים
items.answer_raw: And God said.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הַנָּבִיא
items.answer_raw: The king said to the prophet.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאכְלוּ לֶחֶם
items.answer_raw: They ate bread.

items.body_raw: וַיְדַבֵּר הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶל־הָעָם לֵאמֹר
items.answer_raw: The king spoke to the people, saying,

items.body_raw: וְהֶאֱמִן בַּיהוָה
items.answer_raw: And he believed in Yahweh.

items.body_raw: לֹא תֹאכַל מִמֶּנּוּ
items.answer_raw: You shall not eat of it.

items.body_raw: דַּעַת אֱלֹהִים
items.answer_raw: The knowledge of God

items.body_raw: לֹא תַחְמֹד
items.answer_raw: You shall not covet.

items.body_raw: וָאֹמַר
items.answer_raw: And I said.

items.body_raw: מָה יֹאמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ
items.answer_raw: What will the king say?

items.body_raw: רַק אֶת־דָּמוֹ לֹא תֹאכֵל עַל־הָאָרֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶנּוּ כַּמָּיִם
items.answer_raw: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
